branches: Route to Platform: one output per platform name the model writes
expect.offline: The chain's Structured Output Parser expects a list of {platform, content}; which posts go out depends on the model's reply and on its platform names matching the Switch exactly (Twitter, Discord, LinkedIn or Linkedin; the parser's own example says twitter and discord in lower case). A canned reply fits the schema as an empty list (P41), so the canned run ends at Split Platform Content; recorded replies decide the posts, so the three post replies (X, the Discord webhook, LinkedIn Posts) are unchecked by a canned run. Every post repeats the chat input by design.
